## Why

`stranske/Ready#572` merged the consumer-side capability-bundle registration for `#560`, but lacks the required deliberate-break demonstration.

`scripts/validate_run_contract.py` maps `capability-bundle/v1` in `INGEST_SCHEMA_FILES`; `tests/test_main.py::test_ingest_schema_files_includes_capability_bundle` asserts the mapping exists.

## Scope

Temporarily remove the `capability-bundle/v1` mapping, capture the failing test output, revert, and capture passing output in a follow-up PR linked to `#560`.

## Non-Goals

Do not change schema definitions under `docs/contracts/schemas/`.

No scaffolding or TODO-only changes.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update `scripts/validate_run_contract.py` to temporarily remove `capability-bundle/v1` from `INGEST_SCHEMA_FILES`.
- [ ] Test `tests/test_main.py::test_ingest_schema_files_includes_capability_bundle` with `pytest tests/test_main.py::test_ingest_schema_files_includes_capability_bundle -q` and capture failing output.
- [ ] Revert the `INGEST_SCHEMA_FILES` change, rerun the named test, and add RED and GREEN output blocks to the follow-up PR body.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/test_main.py::test_ingest_schema_files_includes_capability_bundle -q` passes on `main`.
- [ ] Removing `capability-bundle/v1` from `INGEST_SCHEMA_FILES` causes the named test to fail, and reverting the change causes it to pass.
- [ ] The follow-up PR linked to `#560` contains captured RED and GREEN test-output blocks.

## Why (verified evidence)

`stranske/Ready#572` merged the consumer-side capability-bundle registration for `#560`, but the issue requires a deliberate-break demonstration that is absent from the squash diff and PR body.

- PR #572 leaves the deliberate-break acceptance checkbox unchecked and provides no RED/GREEN transcript; `test_ingest_schema_files_requires_capability_bundle_mapping` only asserts the mapping exists on green code.

- [ ] Revert and capture passing output; paste both blocks in the PR body.

- Deliberate-break → revert: remove `capability-bundle/v1` from `INGEST_SCHEMA_FILES` → confirm the named test FAILS → revert and confirm it passes. Paste RED and GREEN blocks in the PR.
